注释(若有): Bloodborne / platinum / All trophies acquired. Hats off!
理由和问题: 官方简中保留英文名 Bloodborne，与 PS4 奖杯一致。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / gold / You lived through the hunt, and saw another day.
理由和问题: 官方译作「亚南」，社区通行「雅南」；站内术语不统一，需统一。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / gold / Captivated by the moon presence, you pledge to watch over the hunter's dream.
Bloodborne / gold / You became an infant Great One, lifting humanity into its next childhood.
Bloodborne / gold / Defeat Yharnam, Blood Queen of the Old Labyrinth.
理由和问题: 官方「修梅里安女王」，与圣杯「修梅露」同源却不同译法。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / gold / Acquire all hunter weapons.
Bloodborne / gold / Acquire all special hunter tools.
Bloodborne / silver / Acquire a weapon of the highest level.
Bloodborne / silver / Acquire an extremely precious blood gem.
理由和问题: 官方把 Blood Gem 译作「神血宝石」，与同表 #29/#30 的「血之宝石」不一致。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / silver / Acquire an extremely precious Caryll Rune.
Bloodborne / silver / Gain entry to Cainhurst, the lost and ruined castle.
Bloodborne / silver / Gain entry to the realm of the Choir, the high stratum of the Healing Church.
Bloodborne / silver / Discover the abandoned old workshop, the source of the hunter's dream.
Bloodborne / silver / Gain entry into the Byrgenwerth lecture building, that drifts within the realm of nightmare.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat the beast that once was Father Gascoigne.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat the beast that once was Vicar Amelia.
理由和问题: 标题为「代理人阿梅利亚」，描述里却写「薇卡•阿梅利亚」；Vicar 在血源官中通常作「代理人」。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat the Shadow of Yharnam.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Great One: Rom, the Vacuous Spider.
理由和问题: 官方语序「罗姆，空虚的蜘蛛」，描述里作「空虚的蜘蛛罗姆」。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat the One Reborn.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Micolash, Host of the Nightmare.
理由和问题: 官方「米克拉什」，社区多用「米克拉什/米科拉什」，英文 Micolash。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Great One: Mergo's Wet Nurse.
理由和问题: 官方「墨戈的乳母」，社区通行「梅高的乳母」（Mergo）。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Cleric Beast.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Blood-starved Beast.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat the Witch of Hemwick.
理由和问题: 官方「亨维科」，社区「亨威克」（Hemwick）。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Darkbeast Paarl.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Great One: Amygdala.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Martyr Logarius.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Great One: Celestial Emissary.
Bloodborne / bronze / Defeat Great One: Ebrietas, Daughter of the Cosmos.
理由和问题: 官方「埃波利耶塔」，社区「伊碧塔丝」（Ebrietas）。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Acquire a blood gem that imbues hunter weapons with special strength.
Bloodborne / bronze / Acquire a Caryll Rune that endows hunters with special strength.
理由和问题: 官方「符文联系人」疑为 Contact 的误译（#29 作「神血宝石新手」同样可疑），建议改「符文接触/血宝石接触」。

注释(若有): Bloodborne / bronze / Acquire the Chalice of Pthumeru that seals the catacombs that form a web deep below Yharnam.
Bloodborne / bronze / Acquire the Chalice of Ailing Loran that seals the tragic land lost to the sands.
Bloodborne / bronze / Acquire the Great Chalice of Isz that seals the home of the cosmic kin.
The Old Hunters / gold / Acquire all old hunter weapons.
理由和问题: 官方「老猎人的精华」，与 #5「猎人的精髓」同词不同译。

注释(若有): The Old Hunters / silver / Defeat Great One: Orphan of Kos.
The Old Hunters / bronze / Defeat the beast that was once Ludwig, the Holy Blade.
理由和问题: 标题用「路德维格」，描述里却写「路德维希」，同一名两译，需统一。

注释(若有): The Old Hunters / bronze / Defeat Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower.
官方英文: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower
官方中文: 精神钟塔的玛利亚修女
推荐名: 精神钟塔的玛利亚修女
理由和问题: 官方「精神钟塔的玛利亚修女」，社区通行「星辰钟塔的玛利亚女士」（Astral Clocktower / Lady Maria）。

注释(若有): The Old Hunters / bronze / Defeat the failed attempts to become Great Ones.
The Old Hunters / bronze / Defeat the beast that was once Laurence, the First Vicar.
理由和问题: 官方「劳伦斯，第一个代理人」，与 #15 的 Vicar 译法一致。
